content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-get-payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-live-2|How to]]-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-honest-side-side-2|payment]] infrastructure designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-fulfillment-explained-digital-18|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]] Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Online gumroad

Stripe and PayPal dominate the digital payment landscape, but with a mere 46 countries supported, their reach is limited. Gumroad offers a user-friendly interface for selling digital goods but is similarly constrained by geographic restrictions. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, like the Edge Commerce Stack, provides creators with complete ownership and control over their online stores. This stack utilizes Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments to enable creators to process payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies without relying on traditional banking systems. By providing a comprehensive solution that includes automated payment processing and file delivery, creators can focus on their products rather than worrying about platform limitations.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe's operational limitations mean that creators in many regions face a harsh reality: they simply cannot access its services. PayPal, while more widely accepted, can suspend accounts and hold funds for up to 180 days without an appeal, creating an unreliable environment for creators. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also exclude specific countries from their services, effectively shutting out entire markets of digital creators. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, however, offers a permanent alternative to these restrictive platforms. With no geographical limitations and no need for KYC, creators from any region can sell digital products seamlessly, thus breaking free from these imposed restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed and fees are critical factors when choosing a digital commerce platform. Stripe typically processes payments within a few days but imposes fees that can add up quickly. PayPal's fees can vary, and the risk of account suspension adds an extra layer of anxiety. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also come with their own fee structures which may not be favorable. The Edge Commerce Stack, on the other hand, integrates with NOWPayments, allowing creators to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a minimal 0.5% fee. Transactions are confirmed instantly on-chain, ensuring that funds are available immediately without the restrictions that traditional banks impose. This not only enhances cash flow but also reduces the overall cost of doing business.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure puts you in control—no more restrictions.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is often overlooked but is a significant concern for digital sellers. Platforms like Stripe and PayPal hold a degree of control over your sales and customer data. In contrast, with a sovereign commerce stack, creators own everything post-deployment. The Edge Commerce Stack automates payment processing and product delivery, ensuring that upon confirmation of payment, digital products are delivered instantly to the consumer. This level of automation not only streamlines operations but also empowers creators to maintain full control over their businesses without relying on third-party platforms.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs and the restrictions you face. If you are in a region excluded by platforms like Stripe or PayPal, transitioning to sovereign commerce infrastructure is a wise choice. The Edge Commerce Stack is particularly suited for those looking for a quick setup with minimal overhead costs. It offers a fully operational online store with built-in payment processing and product delivery in just 48 hours. This allows you to focus on creating and selling your products, rather than navigating complex and often restrictive payment systems.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Instant payment confirmation means instant access to funds.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
